metric: Pairs decided from SQL and column names alone: 861 proved equivalent, 1874 proved different by a counterexample database, 65 unknown. All 2,800 pairs are also in VeriEQL's LeetCode set, which keeps the keys these files drop.
caveats: Rewrite rules were written while looking at these pairs; the held-out fifth was reserved partway through, so it is a weak check. The published labels assume LeetCode's keys and NOT NULL rules, which the files omit, so 476 pairs labelled equivalent get a valid counterexample here. Data is downloaded from a pinned commit (no licence file, not bundled). The October counterexample-search changes (seed per pair, duplicate rows, three-decimal values, date and divisor neighbours) were developed on dev pairs only; the held-out fifth was not inspected. The outer-join flattening rules (outer_join_flatten.py) were developed on dev pairs only. The structural aggregate rules were developed on dev pairs only. The set-split rules (set_split_rules.py, #389) were developed on dev pairs only (failing-tests cluster 11, all 72 dev). The ABS(x - y) facts and the x <> y split (#403) were developed on dev pairs only (cluster 11, 5 dev pairs). Measured on master 30eb0cb, after #403. One pair that compares a string with a number moved from unknown to unsupported when the provers began declining such comparisons (#542, #547); the score and the 862 proofs are unchanged. One more pair (a COALESCE that returns a string for a NULL and a number otherwise, compared with a number) moved from proved to unsupported when kinds began to be inferred from the query (#613): the proof was right on MySQL by luck ('SOME BOGUS VALUE' reads as 0) but rested on a string never equalling a number; the pair is a dev pair. The pairs carry no column types, so the harness now declares each column the queries compare with a string as text, the same reading its counterexample search uses; without it the new untyped-column check (#613) would decline 17 proofs that compare two different product-name strings, 4 of them held out (no pair was inspected, the check was found from the proof counts alone). The score and the 861 proofs are unchanged.
correctness: 0 wrong: every proof re-checked on 900 random DuckDB databases; every 'different' carries a database on which DuckDB returns different bags (numbers compared as rounded floats, fractions exact in binary)
held_out: 560/580, 0 wrong (held-out fifth, by hash of the pair)
